'''''Novar's Bluff''''' was a [[Lianna-class corvette|''Lianna''-class corvette]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was outfitted with an experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] constructed by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]].
